response.sql: WITH college_counts AS (SELECT c.college_id, CASE WHEN c.state IS NULL OR TRIM(c.state) = '' THEN '' ELSE c.state END AS state, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) AS player_count FROM player_college AS pc JOIN college AS c ON c.college_id = pc.college_id GROUP BY c.college_id, CASE WHEN c.state IS NULL OR TRIM(c.state) = '' THEN '' ELSE c.state END), overall AS (SELECT AVG(1.0 * player_count) AS average_count, SUM(player_count) AS total_count FROM college_counts) SELECT cc.state, AVG(1.0 * cc.player_count) AS average_player_count, AVG(1.0 * cc.player_count / NULLIF(o.average_count, 0)) AS average_relative_to_overall_average, AVG(1.0 * cc.player_count / NULLIF(o.total_count, 0)) AS average_share_of_overall_total FROM college_counts AS cc CROSS JOIN overall AS o GROUP BY cc.state

assumptions.assumption: Each college_id identifies one college and has one state; the schema does not enforce this.
Blank, whitespace-only, and NULL states form one group, reported as an empty string.
